title: Many uses
text: Many uses. The installation was a little weird.. I assumed it would be secured with double sided sticky tape but instead you install it with single side adhesive with a screw and nut holding it to the rack (pictured)... and one of my nuts was bad and wouldn't screw in all the way so I was only able to utilize 5 of the 6 racks... I used some for my shoes and the others as a water bottle holder next to my desk and a hair dryer rack in my bathroom.
